title: Square Cut Late And Wide (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, the cut shot, short and wide outside off
Dont reach for it. WAIT for it.

[Verse 1]
Short ball, width outside off, here it comes
Back foot moves back and across the crease
Weight on the back foot, bat horizontal
Wait wait wait then cut with release

Bat comes down through horizontal plane
Contact behind the line of the body frame
Follow through low and square, toward third man
Short and wide is yours, that is the plan

[Pre-Chorus]
Back foot back and across first
Wait for width, no reaching in thirst
Horizontal bat, cut through square
Back foot cut, get back there

[Chorus]
Square cut late and wide outside off
Back foot positioned, bat comes cross
Horizontal swing, follow low through square
Square cut late and wide, that is the shot right there

[Verse 2]
The early cut, that is the wicket taker
Wait till the ball is truly square or later
Back of length, width, those two factors line up
Short and wide, back foot, fill that cup

[Bridge]
Bluey: Back foot, cuts it HARD through point, beautiful square cut
Trevor: He waited exceptionally well, the patience on the back foot is the key
Chas: I made him wait in the backyard forty-five minutes before I would throw him the cut ball

[Chorus]
Square cut late and wide outside off
Back foot positioned, bat comes cross
Horizontal swing, follow low through square
Square cut late and wide, that is the shot right there

[Outro]
Wait for it son
Wait for it
Thats my boy
